objective: One screen with two tabs: Kanban Crossdock Master (part number level) and Export Crossdock Master (part + calculation period + destination level).
Kanban Crossdock Master tab: To register crossdock candidate parts (Part No, Period, Min MAD, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day).
Kanban Crossdock Master tab: To search and display registered crossdock parts with their status and capacity.
Kanban Crossdock Master tab: To change part data and part status (Candidate / Active / Inactive) of a registered part.
Kanban Crossdock Master tab: To display the change history of a part.
Kanban Crossdock Master tab: To export the Kanban Crossdock Master to Excel and upload part settings from Excel (Add and Edit).
Kanban Crossdock Master tab: This sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a Procurement account; users with a D/S account open the Export Crossdock Master sub-menu instead.
Export Crossdock Master tab: To split the Max Case/Day of each Active part over destinations (Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam) for the ongoing calculation period.
Export Crossdock Master tab: To display the destination mapping per part and calculation period, including past periods (read only).

Export Crossdock Master tab: To send the changes of the Current and Next period to AP POLE (XD07) and GTOPAS (XD06) with [Sync], and show the Sync Status of each part (worked out from the staging tables).
Export Crossdock Master tab: To export the mapping to Excel and upload the mapping of the ongoing period from Excel.
Export Crossdock Master tab: This sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a D/S account; users with a Procurement account open the Kanban Crossdock Master sub-menu instead.

buttons.name: Upload Excel (Mapping)

buttons.name: Export Excel (Mapping)

screen_mode_remarks: 1) Prev is disabled on the first page and Next on the last page.
2) A user logged in with a read-only account sees [View] instead of [Edit] and cannot use Add Part / Upload Excel / Save. TBD: which accounts are read-only is not defined yet.
3) Run calculation is shown as D (disabled) by default; it is enabled only when the scheduled DAD Volume Calculation has failed 3 times (auto retry).
4) Sync is enabled only when a staging table has a row with SYNC_STATUS 0 (AP POLE: Current / Next, GTOPAS: Current), not limited to the listed rows.
5) Split evenly is shown only in edit mode when the part has more than one destination row.
7) Prev is disabled on the first page and Next on the last page.
8) Run calculation is enabled only when the scheduled XD05 DAD Volume Calculation (process 2) has failed 3 times (auto retry); otherwise disabled with message no. 30 as tooltip.
6) A user logged in with a read-only account cannot use Edit mapping, Sync or Upload Excel. TBD: which accounts are read-only is not defined yet.
9) '-' = the button is not on the tab of the mode.

operation.text: 5.1 - 5.10: Kanban Crossdock Master tab. 5.11 - 5.20: Export Crossdock Master tab. 5.25: table changes of every save.

items: The sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a Procurement account.
Search criteria: 'Part Number' and 'Part Name' blank, 'Status' = All, 'Sort by' = Newer to Older.
Retrieve all parts of TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and display them sorted by CHANGED_DT descending, 25 rows per page, page 1.
If no part is registered at all, hide the table and display message no. 2 with [Upload Excel] and [Add one part].
The criteria are applied when the user clicks [Search] (or presses Enter in 'Part Number' / 'Part Name'); changing a criterion alone does not change the list. 'Sort by' is applied at once.
'Part Number' and 'Part Name' match by 'contains', case-insensitive; 'Status' matches exactly. All criteria are combined with AND.
Clicking [Search] or changing 'Sort by' or 'Rows per page' returns the list to page 1.

A Candidate part is not sent (no staging row).

Close the modal, reset the Part Number / Part Name / Status filters, sort Newer to Older and display message no. 9. The new part is shown at the top. Table changes: refer 5.25.

'Min MAD' (mandatory, whole number 0 or more), 'Pcs/Case' and 'Max Case/Day' can be changed; 'Total Pcs/Day' is recalculated.

Start the RPA parent flow with the run ID (refer UISS-Batch XD06 / XD07). Display message no. 27.

operation.text: Interface functions (one per target system; refer UISS-Batch XD06 and XD07).

items: The parent flow checks the run: with GTOPAS rows (a part becomes Active or Inactive, a destination is added or removed) XD06 runs first and XD07 starts only when GTOPAS succeeded; without GTOPAS rows XD07 runs at once.

XD06 adds or deletes the part + destination rows of the run on GTOPAS WVJA5204. XD07 uploads the files of the run from the views V_APPOLE_UPLOAD_EXPORT / _KANBAN in the order EXPORT_PRE, KANBAN, EXPORT_POST.
The bots write nothing back to NSP; the result comes by the notification e-mail (SUCCESS / FAILED).

operation.text: When the e-mail says FAILED, the D/S team clicks [Re-send last Sync]: the rows of the last run ID are sent again in the same order (the bot sets values, so a repeat is safe).

Interface method: one Power Automate parent flow per run starts XD06 (RPA on GTOPAS WVJA5204) and XD07 (RPA upload of LLM9Q880 / LLM9Q910 to AP POLE); the RPA reads only the staging tables and the views (refer UISS-Batch XD06 / XD07).

The XD05 process 2 (mapping destination) batch runs on its own scheduler (set in system master) with 3 auto retries. It creates the new calculation period and its destination mapping (refer UISS-Batch XD05 DAD Volume Calculation (process 2)).
The section header shows 'Last mapping calculation' (last successful run) and, when the scheduled run and its 3 retries have failed, the badge 'Scheduled run failed 3x'.

AP POLE Export rows (LLM9Q880 format); refer 5.24.

operation.text: The sync status is not kept on TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE: every value change is a row of TB_H_STG_APPOLE_KANBAN, TB_H_STG_APPOLE_EXPORT or TB_H_STG_GTOPAS with its SYNC_STATUS. TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE keeps the screen history.

items: Names: sub-menu Part List = Kanban Crossdock Master (Procurement), sub-menu Mapping per Destination = Export Crossdock Master (D/S). Page title Crossdock Master. Export Excel: Crossdock_Kanban_Master_YYYYMMDD.xlsx (sheet Kanban Crossdock Master) and Crossdock_Export_Master_<Period>_YYYYMMDD.xlsx (sheet Export Crossdock Master).
Kanban Crossdock Master (former Part List) has a period like the Export Crossdock Master: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE is kept per PART_NO + PERIOD (Status, Pcs/Case and Max Case/Day of that month).

Kanban Crossdock Master screen: new search criterion Calculation period (All periods / periods, default the ongoing period) and new first column Period. Rows of a past period: Part Number and [Edit] not available, [History] available. Add Part: into the ongoing period (default) or the next period.

Periods: Past = view only; Current (M) = changed by screen and upload; Next (M+1) = made by XD05 on day D (system master), view only until day 1. On day 1 the Period Rollover (XD05 process 3) makes Next the Current period.

Order Type per destination row (system master '**', 'C', '9', 'V'): the same destination may have two rows in a period when the order type differs; key PART_NO + PERIOD + DEST_CODE + ORDER_TYPE. Export Crossdock Master: new column Order Type (combobox of the system master) after Destination (CD); Save is blocked when a destination + order type is used twice ("The same destination is used twice with the same order type").
Export Excel / Upload of the Export Crossdock Master: new column Order Type after Destination Code (sheet 1 and sheet Upload).

Max Case/Day of a period may not be below the mapped total of that period (message 14): to lower it, D/S first reduces the destinations on the Export Crossdock Master, then changes Max Case/Day on the Kanban Crossdock Master.

[Sync] and Sync Status are per part and period (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE key PART_NO + TARGET_SYSTEM + PERIOD): XD07 sends the Current period first, then the Next period; XD06 uses the Current period only.
Every save calls the stored procedure SP_STG_WRITE once per changed value, in the same transaction and after the master tables are updated. A save without a changed value writes nothing.

Kanban (TB_H_STG_APPOLE_KANBAN): a change of Pcs/Case or Max Case/Day of an Active part writes a row with the values after the change (ACTION EDIT); Candidate -> Active and a part of a new period write ACTION ADD. OPERATION_TYPE compares the new Max with the last Max sent to AP POLE (same period, else the latest earlier period): 1 = Max down, 2 = Max up, 3 = Max same, 4 = never sent.

Export (TB_H_STG_APPOLE_EXPORT): one row per added (ADD), changed (EDIT) or removed (DELETE, Max Shipping Box (RCS) 0) destination + order type. Active -> Inactive writes DELETE (0) for every destination of the part.

GTOPAS (TB_H_STG_GTOPAS): a row only when the destination appears or disappears for the part (any order type) and GTOPAS does not have that state yet. A Case/Day change or an order type change of a destination that stays writes no GTOPAS row.

Header: an Export change of a part + period without an unsent Kanban row writes the Kanban header with ACTION KEEP and OPERATION_TYPE 5 (current Kanban values, not uploaded). So every part of a run has one Kanban row that sets its upload order.

Superseded: a new row of a key marks the older unsent row of the same key SYNC_STATUS 2. A value set back to the value already sent for the period gets SYNC_STATUS 2 too (nothing to send). Keys: Kanban PERIOD + PART_NO; Export PERIOD + NSP_PART_NO + DEST_CODE + ORDER_TYPE; GTOPAS PERIOD + P_NO + DESTINATION_CODE.
NSP keeps the end state valid before the save: total Case/Day of the destinations <= Max Case/Day of the part in the period (XD01 messages 14 and 20, XD02 / XD03 checks).

[Sync] calls SP_STG_SYNC with a new run ID (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS). It calculates nothing: it locks the staging tables for a moment (a save at the same time waits), sets SYNC_STATUS 0 -> 1 with SYNC_DT and SYNC_RUN_ID on the AP POLE rows of the Current and Next period and on the GTOPAS rows of the Current period, and sets the System Master parameter LAST_SYNC_DATE_APPOLE. Then it starts the RPA parent flow with the run ID.

Upload files of AP POLE (views): EXPORT_PRE (LLM9Q880, order 1) = Export rows of the parts whose Kanban row of the run has OPERATION_TYPE 1; KANBAN (LLM9Q910, order 2) = Kanban rows of the run with OPERATION_TYPE 1 to 4; EXPORT_POST (LLM9Q880, order 3) = every other Export row of the run. Inside a file, per part, rows going down or DELETE (ROW_ORDER 1) come before rows going up or ADD (ROW_ORDER 2). An empty file is not made. File name <template>_<RUN_ID>_<order>_<name>.xls.

RPA parent flow: a run with GTOPAS rows (a part becomes Active or Inactive, a destination is added or removed) runs XD06 first and XD07 only when GTOPAS succeeded; a run without GTOPAS rows runs XD07 only. The Period Rollover runs XD06 only.

The robots write nothing back to NSP; the result comes by the notification e-mail. When it says FAILED, the D/S team clicks [Re-send last Sync] before the next [Sync]: the same run ID, the same rows and order.
Rows of a past period that were not sent before the Period Rollover are never taken again: every selection has a PERIOD condition.

Sync Status per part + period: AP POLE Non Sync while TB_H_STG_APPOLE_KANBAN or TB_H_STG_APPOLE_EXPORT has a row with SYNC_STATUS 0, else Sync; GTOPAS Non Sync while TB_H_STG_GTOPAS has a row with SYNC_STATUS 0, else Sync. Last Sent = latest SYNC_DT of the target.

tables.name: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: History of every change of a crossdock part for the History setting of XD01 (Add / Edit by screen or upload, mapping changes, status changes and mappings made by the calculation batches). The sync to GTOPAS / AP POLE is not recorded here: it is in the staging tables (TB_H_STG_APPOLE_KANBAN, TB_H_STG_APPOLE_EXPORT, TB_H_STG_GTOPAS). No retention limit.
columns: Calculation period YYYYMM of the changed row (every event; Kanban and Export Crossdock Master are per period)
Upload of the change (Log); NULL when not from an upload
Destination code (7 digits) for MAPPING; NULL for other events
Order Type of the destination row for MAPPING (with DEST_CODE); NULL for other events
Changed field: PCS_CASE, MAX_CASE_DAY, MIN_MAD, PART_STATUS, CASE_DAY
Value before the change; NULL for ADD or an added destination
Value after the change; NULL for a removed destination
User who made the change (batch user ID for BATCH)
Date and time of the change

tables.name: TB_H_STG_APPOLE_KANBAN
columns: Running number: order of the inserts
Calculation period YYYYMM. FK1 (PART_NO, PERIOD) -> TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE
ADD (new part, new period) / EDIT (Pcs/Case or Max changed) / KEEP (header written by an Export save, Kanban unchanged)
Active / Inactive in the period when the row is written (an Inactive part stays in the AP POLE Kanban)
MM/YYYY of PERIOD. File / screen column: Effective Month / Year
Always P6. File / screen column: Operator ID. Default 'P6'
Part number with "-" (NSP format); FK1. File / screen column: Part No.
From TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE at the insert. File / screen column: Part Name
Pcs/Case. File / screen column: Shipping Box Qty
Max Case/Day. File / screen column: Max Shipping Box Qty
Shipping Box Qty x Max Shipping Box Qty. File / screen column: Max Allowance Qty

Header of the part, set by SP_STG_WRITE at the save: 1 = Max down, 2 = Max up, 3 = Max same (only Pcs/Case changed, or a new period with the same Max), 4 = never sent, 5 = Kanban unchanged, only the destinations changed (ACTION KEEP). 1 to 4 against the last Max sent: same period, else the latest earlier period. Upload: 1 -> the Export rows of the part in EXPORT_PRE before KANBAN; 2, 3, 4 -> KANBAN then EXPORT_POST; 5 -> EXPORT_POST only, the row is not in the KANBAN file
Upload of the Kanban or Export Excel (Log); NULL when SOURCE is not UPLOAD
0 = to send, 1 = sent, 2 = Superseded at the save (a newer row of the key, or back to the value already sent). Set by SP_STG_WRITE (0, 2) and SP_STG_SYNC / Period Rollover (1). Default '0'
Time of the [Sync] / Period Rollover that sent the row; Last Sent on the screen = latest value
Run ID YYYYMMDDHHMMSS; [Re-send last Sync] sends the rows of the last run again
User of the save / upload, or XD05BATCH
Time of the insert (same transaction as the master update)
User of the save that made the row Superseded, of [Sync], or XD05BATCH (Period Rollover)
tables.description: AP POLE Kanban rows in the format of the upload file LLM9Q910, one row per Kanban change of a part + period, plus the header row (OPERATION_TYPE 5) when only the destinations changed. Written by SP_STG_WRITE (XD01, XD02, XD05); SYNC_STATUS set by SP_STG_SYNC. Read by XD07 through V_APPOLE_UPLOAD_KANBAN and V_APPOLE_UPLOAD_EXPORT.

tables.name: TB_H_STG_APPOLE_EXPORT
columns: Running number: order of the inserts
Calculation period YYYYMM. FK1 (NSP_PART_NO, PERIOD) -> TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE
Part number with "-" (key back to NSP); FK1
Destination code, 7 digits. No FK: a DELETE row points to a removed destination
ADD / EDIT / DELETE (DELETE = Max Shipping Box (RCS) 0)
MM/YYYY of PERIOD. File / screen column: Effective Month / Year
Part number without "-". File / screen column: Part No.
DEST_CODE in 5-2 format. File / screen column: Buyer-PD
'**', 'C', '9', 'V' (system master). File / screen column: Order Type
Always 2. File / screen column: Transport Code. Default '2'
Case/Day of the destination; 0 = delete. File / screen column: Max Shipping Box (RCS)
Upload of the Kanban or Export Excel (Log); NULL when SOURCE is not UPLOAD

Time of the [Sync] / Period Rollover that sent the row; Last Sent on the screen = latest value
Run ID YYYYMMDDHHMMSS; [Re-send last Sync] sends the rows of the last run again
User of the save / upload, or XD05BATCH
Time of the insert (same transaction as the master update)
User of the save that made the row Superseded, of [Sync], or XD05BATCH (Period Rollover)
tables.description: AP POLE Export rows in the format of the upload file LLM9Q880, one row per added, changed or removed destination + order type of a part + period. Written by SP_STG_WRITE (XD01, XD03, XD05); SYNC_STATUS set by SP_STG_SYNC. Read by XD07 through V_APPOLE_UPLOAD_EXPORT.

Part number with "-"; FK1. File / screen column: P/No.
7-digit code, the same in NSP and GTOPAS. File / screen column: Destination Code
Always A. File / screen column: Maker Code. Default 'A'
Always 2. File / screen column: Domestic/Overseas. Default '2'
Always 3. File / screen column: TOPAS Order Type. Default '3'
Always 2. File / screen column: Order Transportation Code. Default '2'
Upload of the Kanban or Export Excel (Log); NULL when SOURCE is not UPLOAD
0 = to send, 1 = sent, 2 = Superseded at the save (a newer row of the key, or back to the value already sent). Set by SP_STG_WRITE (0, 2) and SP_STG_SYNC / Period Rollover (1). Default '0'
Time of the [Sync] / Period Rollover that sent the row; Last Sent on the screen = latest value
Run ID YYYYMMDDHHMMSS; [Re-send last Sync] sends the rows of the last run again
User of the save / upload, or XD05BATCH
Time of the insert (same transaction as the master update)
User of the save that made the row Superseded, of [Sync], or XD05BATCH (Period Rollover)
tables.description: GTOPAS WVJA5204 rows: a part + destination to add or delete, written by SP_STG_WRITE only when the destination appears or disappears for the part (any order type) and GTOPAS does not have that state yet. Sent by [Sync] (Current period) or the Period Rollover (new Current period). Read by XD06.

revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: Sync Status rule: No Sync only when a value sent to GTOPAS / AP POLE changes; a manual Active -> Inactive is taken by [Sync] (FB-204 / FB-205).

revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: [Sync] takes every part with status Active (ongoing period) or Inactive whose Sync Status is No Sync or Failed, whatever the filter shows (Candidate never).

revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: Sheet "Active to Inactive" removed (18-Nov): Inactive parts with No Sync / Failed are taken by [Sync] by their status. Export Excel of Export Crossdock Master has 2 sheets again; column Last Sync stays.

revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: Names Kanban / Export Crossdock Master; period on the Kanban Crossdock Master; Order Type per destination row; Max Case/Day down: destinations first (19-Nov).

revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: Sync without response from the RPA: Sync Status No Sync / Sent, column Last Sent, button [Re-send last Sync] (20-Nov).

revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT removed: send time per target on TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE (GTOPAS_SYNC_DT, APPOLE_SYNC_DT, SYNC_RUN_ID); columns Last Sent GTOPAS / AP POLE; Log per run; history SYNC by NSP (20-Nov).

revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: Sync with TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE_STG_SYNC (22-Nov): no sync column on TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE; staging rows per value change (screen); [Sync] sets status / SEND_SEQ / run ID; Sync Status AP POLE / GTOPAS worked out from the staging (5.24).
